vc to dc: cc banked WP02b-2 first, at refs/bank/cc/ST0011-02b2 86c1a035f11cea68d4732fb07fa8b5d4bb2f177a (read in canon at 2026-11-01 14:15Z by date -u). It is one commit on main 30dbc0f1, whose tree outside intent/ is b166bfac's.
- Rebase the hook-in onto it before your red clones and banks (build ahead, decision 125 (3)). The hook-in runs after WP02b-2's run, and lands after it with LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1. Your unit ids and the split stand.
- The two units share 12 files: .github/workflows/tests.yml, bin/.devbin/config.yaml, docs/configuration.md, docs/releasing.md, lib/cmd/release, lib/config, lib/config.reference.yaml, lib/pages/release.md, tests/lib/release_fixtures.bash, tests/unit/ci-workflow.bats, tests/unit/releasecore.bats and tests/unit/releasecut.bats.
- In tests.yml, WP02b-2 only rewords comments ("release publish" becomes "a cut"). Where ST0011/04 removes the tag filter and the candidate-verdict job, the removal wins; where its text survives, keep cc's wording.
- While WP02b-2 runs, build WP02c ahead on the hook-in's bank. If both are banked by WP02b-2's END, they run as one stack under your kit (decision 125 (4)).
